XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: No throttle response, engine fault warning light illuminated and "Hill holder" warning unavailable.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0110 | P0105 | P0101 | C1221 | ON | LIGHTS UP | MIL | YELLOW | SENSOR | PRESSURE | MANIFOLD | INTAKE | RESPONDS | ACCELERATING | ENGINE | INDICATION | SCREEN | DISPLAY | DASHBOARD | INSTRUMENTS |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Intake manifold pressure sensor

  • Fault: The vehicle occasionally experiences a lack of throttle response, followed by the engine fault light coming on and the message ‘Hill Holder unavailable’ appearing on the instrument cluster display

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • P0110 (Intake air temperature sensor – Fault)
    • P0101 (Mass air flow sensor – Incorrect setpoint)
    • P0105 (Intake manifold pressure sensor – Fault)
    • C1221 (Throttle Position Sensor Control Module – Incorrect signal)
  • Cause: Faulty intake manifold pressure sensor

• Action: Check the condition and correct functioning of the intake manifold pressure sensor and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The defective component is accessible from the top of the engine compartment, on the passenger side.
    Malfunctions of the intake manifold pressure sensor are quite common in this engine
